cases.expected: Returns a non‑null JsonSchema object representing the supplied schema; the schema is pre‑loaded without throwing any exception.
cases.description: Happy‑path test: a well‑formed schema location and a default configuration should result in a successfully created JsonSchema instance.

cases.expected: Returns a non‑null JsonSchema object; preload is executed with the supplied configuration (fail‑fast enabled).
cases.description: Ensures that a custom configuration is correctly propagated to the preload step.

cases.expected: Throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because schemaUri is required.
cases.description: Verifies that the method validates the mandatory schema location argument.

cases.expected: Returns a non‑null JsonSchema object; the factory should fall back to a default SchemaValidatorsConfig internally.
cases.description: Checks that a null config does not cause a failure and that a default configuration is used.

cases.expected: Throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because schemaUri is required, irrespective of config.
cases.description: Confirms that the method fails fast when both arguments are null.

cases.expected: Throws a RuntimeException (e.g., JsonSchemaException) indicating that the schema could not be found or loaded.
cases.description: Ensures that a missing schema resource propagates an appropriate exception from loadSchema.

cases.expected: Throws a JsonSchemaException (or IOException) because the schema content is not valid JSON/YAML.
cases.description: Validates that parsing errors inside loadSchema are surfaced to the caller.

cases.expected: Returns a JsonSchema instance; preload completes without StackOverflowError, handling circular $ref gracefully.
cases.description: Tests that the private preload method correctly detects and handles circular references.

cases.expected: Returns a JsonSchema instance; preload caches sub‑schemas as configured.
cases.description: Verifies that configuration flags affecting preload (e.g., caching) are honoured.

cases.expected: Returns a non‑null JsonSchema object; the YAML content is correctly parsed into a JsonNode and pre‑loaded without throwing an exception.
cases.description: Verifies that a schema stored as YAML (detected by .yaml extension) is handled by getSchema, confirming that the internal YamlMapper is used.

cases.expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException (or URISyntaxException wrapped in RuntimeException) because the supplied schema location is not a valid URI.
cases.description: Ensures that malformed URIs are detected early and result in a clear exception rather than an obscure loading error.

cases.expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException because an empty schema location string is not allowed.
cases.description: Checks that an empty string passed to SchemaLocation is rejected.

cases.expected: Throws JsonSchemaException (or IOException) indicating that the schema content could not be parsed because the file is empty.
cases.description: Validates that an empty schema resource is treated as a parsing error and propagated to the caller.

cases.expected: Returns a JsonSchema instance whose preload step resolves the external $ref located at classpath:/schemas/externally-referenced.json without throwing StackOverflowError.
cases.description: Tests that preload correctly follows a $ref to another classpath resource and loads it, confirming proper interaction with SchemaLoaders.

cases.expected: First call returns a non‑null JsonSchema; a second call with the same SchemaLocation and a config that also has cache enabled returns the *same* JsonSchema instance (reference equality).
cases.description: Confirms that when caching is enabled, the factory reuses previously loaded schema objects, reducing loading overhead.

cases.expected: Returns a JsonSchema object; the internal SchemaValidatorsConfig attached to the schema has typeLoose set to true, which will later affect validation of numeric/string type coercion.
cases.description: Ensures that the typeLoose flag supplied via SchemaValidatorsConfig is preserved in the created JsonSchema, even though validation is not performed in this method.

cases.expected: Returns a JsonSchema object when the underlying HTTP client (mocked) supplies a valid JSON schema; otherwise a JsonSchemaException is thrown. In the test environment the HTTP call is stubbed to return a known schema.
cases.description: Verifies that getSchema can handle HTTP(S) URIs by delegating to the registered SchemaLoader; the test uses a mock HTTP responder to avoid network dependency.

cases.expected: When invoked concurrently from multiple threads with the same arguments, all threads receive a non‑null JsonSchema instance and no race conditions or duplicate loads occur (the same cached instance is returned).
cases.description: Ensures that the internal ConcurrentHashMap used for caching is correctly synchronized, preventing duplicate schema loading under concurrent usage.

cases.expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException stating that the URI scheme 'ftp' is not supported by JsonSchemaFactory.
cases.description: Ensures that a schema location using an unsupported protocol (ftp) is rejected early with a clear exception.

cases.expected: Throws IOException (or JsonSchemaException) because the resolved resource points to a directory rather than a readable schema file.
cases.description: Verifies that providing a SchemaLocation that resolves to a directory results in a loading failure rather than an obscure null pointer.

cases.expected: Throws JsonSchemaException indicating that the $ref '#/definitions/NonExistent' could not be resolved within the same schema.
cases.description: Tests that a $ref pointing to a non‑existent internal definition is detected and reported as a schema loading error.

cases.expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException (or JsonSchemaException) because the schema declares an unknown $schema IRI that cannot be mapped to a JsonMetaSchema.
cases.description: Ensures that schemas referencing an unrecognised meta‑schema IRI cause a clear failure during meta‑schema resolution.

cases.expected: Throws JsonSchemaException (or IOException) because the HTTP request returns a 404 status, indicating the remote schema could not be retrieved.
cases.description: Validates that getSchema correctly propagates HTTP error codes (e.g., 404) as exceptions rather than silently returning a null schema.

cases.expected: Throws JsonSchemaException (or a custom RecursionDepthExceededException) before a StackOverflowError occurs, indicating that the factory detects and aborts overly deep $ref recursion.
cases.description: Confirms that the implementation has a safeguard against unbounded $ref recursion and fails gracefully with a meaningful exception.

cases.expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException because a fragment‑only location cannot be resolved without a base schema document.
cases.description: Ensures that a SchemaLocation consisting solely of a fragment is rejected, as the factory requires a resolvable base URI to load the schema.
